blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Supreme Court has dismissed the two petitions challenging the Senate Impeachment court’s ruling on the voting threshold required to convict Vice President Sara Duterte. Former Executive Secretary Vic Rodriguez and lawyer Ernesto Francisco Jr. filed the two separate petitions, both seeking judicial intervention after the Senate adjusted the constitutional two-thirds voting requirement.
